subject: James exact-source gun removal; chain/prop delivery reconciliation
body:
CFA NOVA coordinating Ziggy’s new James decision. Please check your in-flight work first and avoid a duplicate. One bounded edit only: the exact man in HD-RETURN-957897bd45c4 / 957897bd45c4__HIP-COAT-01_v001.jpg is now James, Lisan Al Gaib’s brother. Use the selected gun variant, NOT ancestor HD-DROP-45892924b234.

Source on D: D:/Documents/CFA/docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/hon_dolo_strictly_business/grok_return_20261009/received/content/957897bd45c4__HIP-COAT-01_v001.jpg
306212 bytes; SHA256 957897bd45c4fc03d685c4a40af7670385ab3970108cdbd319d839385dceacc1; 1280x720.

Remove only the visible physical gun. Keep his exact face, smile, tattoos (including circular astrolabe chest), black open leather coat, clothing, jewelry/chains, pose, hands/body, lighting, framing, hangar and ship ramp. Preserve the holster and straps. Reconstruct only the pixels uncovered by gun removal. Prefer a localized edit if your route supports it; report actual method and any drift. Return ONE separately named derivative with source/output hashes, bytes/dimensions and defects. Preserve the original. Do not reroll automatically, expand coverage, or treat this as approved DoLo or an accepted James master. If the exact D: image is inaccessible, report that before generation.

Separate status question only, no new chain/prop generation: the dated neck_bling_20261009 PLAN still says prepared_not_sent; it proposes 24 chain discovery designs, not a confirmed delivery. What neck-chain or mouth-prop work actually was dispatched, and what already exists? Please provide exact package filenames/paths/hashes or distinguish pending/not sent. Reconcile the earlier separate 50-item prop request rather than replacing or duplicating it. Product-first jewelry display is being handled by Site; no batch restart is requested.

Keep V1’s private calibration map/answer key isolated; this message does not authorize reading, copying or grading that private material.
